name: round 1: The machine
tests: renders opaque non-uniform frames at different canvas sizes
reproduces identical pixels after other seeds and times
changes the artwork across distinct animation times
changes the artwork when the seed changes
aligns corner and neighbouring slice crops with the whole machine
rejects malformed seeds after rendering a valid seed
rejects negative nonfinite and nonnumeric times after a valid time
rejects invalid or out-of-bounds viewports after a valid viewport
plays and pauses the visible artwork
applies preview seeds reproducibly in the viewer
renders without external requests or uncaught browser errors
